Case Study 01 · Onboarding & Retention

Client Success

Automated Course & Community Onboarding

The problemEvery new client meant hours of manual emails, access setup and reminders, and it was easy for steps to slip.
What I builtOne connected system: landing pages, payment-triggered workflows, welcome email sequences, course and community access, and follow-up check-ins.
10+ hrssaved on every client onboarded

Case Study 02 · AI Automation

AI Agents

Multi-Agent AI Triage System

The problemWebsite visitors asked about many different services, and the team had to sort and answer each one by hand.
What I builtA multi-agent system in GoHighLevel AI Studio with 6 voice and chat agents for lead qualification, routing, follow-up and support. A triage agent reads what the visitor needs and hands them to the right specialist, each with its own knowledge base.
  • 6 specialised voice and chat agents + intent-based router
  • Voice AI agent (GPT-4o) qualifies inbound calls in real time
  • Books qualified leads straight onto the calendar
